Gaps and implications

Your customer journey today: a proven class, but no front door that sells every day

1

Your $22 live class is a smart first step, but a live class sells in bursts around each date. In between, there’s no way to monetise the 95%* of your audience who aren’t ready for coaching yet.

Sales in bursts

Revenue follows the calendar

A live class fills up when there’s a date to promote. The weeks in between, women who find you have nothing to buy, so new sales depend on the next session.

Your time

Every sale needs you live

Each session needs you to show up, teach and follow up. That caps how far the class can grow at the number of hours you can give it.

No buyer-to-applicant path

Class buyers stop at the class

Nothing walks a $22 buyer to “I’m ready for coaching” on autopilot, with a bump and upsell that show who’s serious before she reaches your calendar.

Your class is proven. What’s missing is a $27 front door that sells every day without you going live, and a free application that turns buyers into qualified coaching clients.

My recommendation

An always-on $27 entry offer, fed by Meta ads every day

It sits alongside your $22 live class, not in place of it. A self-paced kit with an order bump, an upsell and a downsell. The welcome page invites buyers to your next live session and to a free coaching application, so buyers become applicants.

Questions

Before you grab the kit

Is this investment advice?

No. The kit is money coaching and education about habits, beliefs and planning. It doesn’t recommend any investment, and it isn’t tax or legal advice.

Do I need to be good with numbers?

Not at all. That’s my job. The kit starts with how money feels, then makes the numbers simple.

How long does it take?

The video training is 60 minutes. You can fill in the Spending Map the same day.

Why is it only $27?

Because the first step should be easy. Use the kit, feel the difference, and decide afterwards if you want to go deeper with me.

Educational content, not financial, investment, tax or legal advice. Results vary.

Ad creatives · Video scripts

Ad scripts: talking to camera

Same warm clay backdrop as your profile photo. 30 to 45 seconds each. Add “Educational content, not financial advice” on screen.

Script 1 · “Why budgets don’t stick”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“A CPA’s take on why most budgets don’t last.”

Body

“Budgets fix the numbers. They don’t touch the beliefs behind them, so the same patterns come back. I start one step earlier, with what I call the money mirror: noticing what your spending and saving are reflecting back to you. Then the plan gets a lot easier to keep.”

CTA

“I put the full process in the Money Mirror Reset Kit. It’s $27. Tap Learn more.”

Shot: talking to camera on the clay backdrop, “numbers vs beliefs” appears on screen with “beliefs” highlighted.

Script 2 · “The 20-minute money date”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“The 20-minute weekly habit I recommend to every woman building wealth.”

Body

“Once a week, make a cup of tea and open your accounts. Look at what came in, what went out, and notice how each one felt. Then make one decision. That’s it. Twenty minutes, no shame, every week.”

CTA

“The Money Mirror Reset Kit walks you through it, with the Exhale Spending Map. $27, instant access. Tap Learn more.”

Shot: talking to camera, cut to a laptop and a mug, on-screen checklist of the three steps.

Script 3 · “Wealth that feels like an exhale”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“Building wealth shouldn’t feel like holding your breath.”

Body

“So much money advice is about restriction: cut this, skip that. I’m a finance exec and a CPA, and I teach the opposite order. First see your patterns. Then spend on purpose. Then build the habits that grow wealth, calmly.”

CTA

“Start with the Money Mirror Reset Kit. It’s $27. Tap Learn more.”

Shot: talking to camera, a slow exhale on the hook. Add “Educational content, not financial advice” on screen.
